newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot natgas recovers in slow holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot natgas recovers in slow holiday trade.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices recovered from last week's lows on Monday as forecasts called for a return of cooler weather, market sources said.
However, trading was very light due to the Victoria Day holiday in Canada.
Spot gas at the AECO storage hub was talked about three cents higher in the low-C$1.60s per gigajoule (GJ).
Temperatures in Calgary were forecast to reach highs of only 47 and 51 degrees Fahrenheit on Tuesday and Wednesday, respectively, Weather Services Corp said.
